OD1 (user decision 2026-10-11, HARNESS_PLAN §16, case alina-bld: depth taken from the glass position 17–30 mm).

## What
- `opening_depth_default_m` defaults to **0.4** (`OPENING_DEPTH_DEFAULT_M` in `spec/model.py`, extractor and `openings.assemble`); C24 unchanged: `npm_min` plane at the full depth (0.4), `mid` at half (0.2).
- An opening whose source gives **no depth** (no reveal, or a back polygon flush with the facade, ≤ 1 cm) takes the default and is listed in the extractor report `openings.depth_by_default` (level, wall, x, sill, position) with `openings_depth_by_default` and `depth_default_m` — **never 0, never a minimum, no question** (the old `opening-flush` question is gone). The glass never gives a depth.
- A measured reveal off the default by more than `depth_exception_m` stays a `depth_m` exception.
- Docs: pattern `opening-plane`, `conflicts.md` C24 note, backlog OD1 closed.

## Benchmarks
B01 / B02 / B02t / K01 keep their explicit `opening_depth_default_m: 0.2` in `object.json` (their etalons are 0.2): the chains are unchanged, **9/9** each (branch run). Synthetic extractor tests pin 0.2 (their reveals are 0.2); new tests: the 0.4 default without a value, the report mark, a measured reveal kept.

Full suite 1031 passed (the known timeout-cleanup test aside); schemas 11/11.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

## Review 1 fixes and additions (user: OD1 and K01 decor_tol_m in this PR, 2026-10-12)
- Glass without a reveal gives no depth: the default, listed. Revit openings keep the default as on main (their "depth" is the host wall's thickness, not a reveal, #36), now listed too.
- K01 tolerances: `decor_tol_m` (since #75 the K01 chain stopped on it).
- `check_decor` on a real building: attachment candidates (> 0.8 m, EG2) are no decor; unlisted decor = a box on one wall set into the body deeper than decor is (K01's coping ring and ladder rungs are attachments). K01 decor now fails only on its real id (17, not 26–30). K01 runs to the known engine stop.



## Review 2 fixes (head 9190781)
- Depth provenance: the glass position is never a depth (kept as `glass_at` for searches only, carried through merges); measured planes/reveals keep their depth through merges with glass, also across levels.
- Decor ids by material (user 2026-10-12): metal 16-20 or 26-30, one group per element; K01 strip id 17 = `Metal_RAL5015` (a metal bracket) now passes.
- `check_decor`: unlisted decor-like boxes found up to 0.8 m past a wall end.
- Full suite 1043 passed; B01/B02/B02t 9/9; K01 to the known engine stop (31 questions), decor passes.

## Review 3 fixes
- Unlisted decor-like box past a corner (0.801 m) now fails; the cross-level glass/hole regression is committed.
- Full suite 1045 passed; B01/B02/B02t 9/9; K01 31 questions, decor passes, known engine stop.
- K01 id 17 = metal bracket confirmed by the user (2026-10-12).
